description: FINDER output for the hidden-failure lens at UNIT scope (a whole file or chunk-unit), used by the /deep-audit-run engine. Its own file per the OPS-12 standing rule (every critic owns its schema + artifact). Same finding shape as review/hidden-failure-schema.json so a finding renders identically, but grounded in the unit's CURRENT contents (whole-unit audit), not a diff. The charter, run identity, and the claim-blind verify contract this feeds are defined in SKILL.md — not restated here.

summary.description: One-paragraph assessment of this unit's failure handling: does it surface its own failures, or can it continue in a degraded state nothing reports?

findings.description: Empty array if the unit hides no failure. Report ONLY hidden-failure findings, grounded in the unit's current contents. The engine assigns each finding a stable findingId (runId + index) after collection; the finder does not.

title.description: Short label for the hidden-failure finding.

file.description: Repo-relative path the finding is about (the unit's file).

line.description: 1-indexed line the finding anchors to, or null.

claim.description: How this unit swallows/absorbs/silently degrades on error (bare or blind except|catch, catch-log-continue where propagating is correct, silent fallback, deleted assertion or safety check) and why letting it continue unsurfaced matters.

suggestion.description: Concrete way to surface the failure instead (propagate, assert, fail loudly), or null.
